column1: # The 10,000 frequent words (as frequent.tsv writes them) whose first result with a definition, through a rule of the pack (its trace has one), is another lemma
# or the same lemma matched through more letters with transforms.json than with no transforms (measure.mjs diff frequent none.json final.json --dump),
# judged by the pack author: right (the rule gives the lemma the word nearly always is), wrong, mixed (both readings are common), name (an English name or word
# of the subtitles, wrong either way) or either (a German word the list writes in small letters, wrong either way).
